children: Array Technologies completed acquisition of Affordable Wire Management for approximately $165 million, expected to be at least high single-digit accretive to Adjusted EPS in year one.
Closed acquisition of Affordable Wire Management (AWM) on Aug 31, 2026, under amended July 16, 2026 Purchase Agreement.
Buyer paid approximately $165 million cash, net of customary closing adjustments and subject to final post-closing settlement.
Acquisition expands Array’s balance-of-system portfolio with high-margin wire management and cable protection products.
Transaction expected to be at least high single-digit accretive to Array’s Adjusted EPS in the first year before synergies.
Array cites opportunities to drive growth across utility-scale solar, energy storage, and datacenter applications.
